inputs.name: in_pv
inputs.layout: per (head,token) row: p row (8) | v row (64); split in-graph by two SLICEs. Packed only because e2e.sh feeds 2 runtime inputs.

weights.bias: none in Qwen2.5 (a zero-filled [D] fp16 tensor is still fed, NOTES §5.1: FC wants a third input)

p_source: fixed attention pass on fixture weights: embed rows -> RMSNorm(input_layernorm, eps=1e-6) -> q/k/v (with bias) -> RoPE(theta=1e6) -> scores/sqrt(HD) -> causal mask -> float32 softmax; v replicated 2->14 KV heads (head h uses kv h//7).
reference: numpy float64 on logical tensors (R3: independent of the flatbuffer writer)

fp16sim_lower_bound.method: fp16 rounding at BMM/FC/ADD boundaries, fp32 inside; numpy only

tolerance_reason: NOTES §10.1 form: atol = rtol = 4*2^-11*max|out| = 1.572e-04 (max|out| = 0.08051); device-independent fp16-simulation bound = 6.104e-05 max_abs, registered threshold is 2.6x that bound. The repo default 2e-2 is rejected a priori: it is larger than max|out| itself here, i.e. it could never catch a layout error.
purpose: NEGATIVE control (intentionally WRONG math): the PV output [H,T,HD] is RESHAPEd straight to [T,896] with NO TRANSPOSE (NOTES §10.2 trap). Compiles, runs in one execution step, and shows a large rel_l2 -> proves the main PASS is not vacuous and that the golden catches head-layout errors.
expected_result: compare must FAIL by a large margin (rel_l2 ~ 1e-1)
